between the First Closing and December&nbsp;31, 2026. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;2.08 <U>Specified</U><U> Person</U><U>s</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) The Partnership may (but is not required to) establish a committee (the &#8220;<B><U>Advisory
Committee</U></B>&#8221;), consisting of such number of representatives of Unitholders whose membership shall be determined from time to time, and shall be subject to change, by the General Partner after consultation with the Investment Manager, to
act on behalf of the Unitholders in the circumstances described herein; <I>provided</I> that no voting member of the Advisory Committee shall be an employee, officer, director, partner, consultant or Affiliate of Goldman Sachs (or a representative
thereof). Notwithstanding the foregoing and for the avoidance of doubt, an employee of Goldman Sachs may serve as a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-voting</FONT> member of the Advisory Committee, and the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-voting</FONT> member appointed by Goldman Sachs will have the power and authority to, among other things, convene meetings of the Advisory Committee. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) In addition to the foregoing, the Partnership may engage one or more Independent Persons to act in any
capacity in which the Advisory Committee would be authorized to act in accordance with the terms of this Agreement; <I>provided</I> that (i)&nbsp;any such engagement will be on terms identified at the time of such engagement by the Partnership in
its sole discretion, (ii)&nbsp;any expenses incurred in connection with the engagement of such Independent Person shall be borne by the Partnership and accordingly the Unitholders and (iii)&nbsp;the Partnership expects to indemnify each Independent
Person in their capacity as such, as set forth in Section&nbsp;2.05(b). A Specified Person, at the request of the General Partner and/or the Investment Manager, may consent or not consent to any transaction, or any fee paid to Goldman Sachs or any
of its Affiliates in respect of a transaction, in which the Partnership proposes to be an investor and which, as a result of the participation by Goldman Sachs or any of its Affiliates, requires consent under the Advisers Act, or as to which the
General Partner and/or the Investment Manager otherwise determines to seek consent. A Specified Person may also be requested to (A)&nbsp;review and / or approve other matters, including possible conflicts of interest (including certain investment
allocations) which the Investment Manager determines to present to such Specified Person; and (B)&nbsp;at the discretion of the Investment Manager, with respect to a limited subset of Investments, review and / or approve the nominees for boards of
directors and undertake certain other major decisions with respect to actions proposed to be taken by certain Portfolio Assets. If the Investment Manager consults with a Specified Person with respect to any such transaction, and if such Specified
Person gives its consent to the relevant transaction (and the Investment Manager acts pursuant to such grant of consent), then none of the Investment Manager or any of its Affiliates shall have any liability to the Partnership or any Unitholder for
actions in respect of such matter taken in good faith by them, including actions in the pursuit of their own interests. A consent by any Specified Person or any Independent Person to any matter which requires the consent of a Majority in Interest or
the Partnership, under the Advisers Act, other applicable law and / or this Agreement, or any other matter to which any Specified Person or any Independent Person has given its consent, shall be deemed to constitute, to the maximum extent permitted
by applicable law, the consent of a Majority in Interest. Each Unitholder is deemed to have consented to the submission to a Specified Person of any consent otherwise required of the Partnership. In the discretion of the General Partner, any matter
for which consent or approval of a Specified Person is required or that a Specified Person is authorized to waive may instead be consented to, approved or waived by a Majority in Interest or an Independent Person, which action shall be effective as
if such consent, approval or waiver was given by such Specified Person (and vice versa). </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c) If established, the Advisory Committee will meet on an
<I>ad hoc</I> basis as needed. The General Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager) shall use commercially reasonable efforts to coordinate any request to convene a meeting of the Advisory Committee within fifteen (15)&nbsp;Business Days
following the request of at least a majority of the members of the Advisory Committee. Representatives of the Investment Manager may attend any such meeting. Forty percent (40%) of the voting members of the Advisory Committee (excluding, for the

in lieu of a meeting (in each case, excluding any members that are required to be recused pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.08(g)). Such written consent may be relayed via email or other electronic communication. If a single meeting of the Advisory
Committee is impracticable, the Advisory Committee may hold a series of meetings which together will constitute a single meeting of the Advisory Committee. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(d) Members of the Advisory Committee may participate in a meeting of the Advisory Committee by means of
telephone or video conferencing so long as all persons participating in the meeting can hear and be heard. Any member of the Advisory Committee who is unable to attend a meeting of the Advisory Committee may with the consent of the General Partner
grant in writing to another member of the Advisory Committee or any other Person (including representatives of Goldman Sachs) such member&#8217;s proxy to vote on any matter upon which action is taken at such meeting. The Advisory Committee shall
conduct its business by such other procedures as a majority of its members consider appropriate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(e) No
fees shall be paid by the Partnership to members of the Advisory Committee, but the Partnership shall (i)&nbsp;bear all reasonable and documented <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> expenses
for travel, lodging and meal expenses for Advisory Committee members to attend an <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-person</FONT> meeting called and scheduled by the Investment Manager no more than once per year; <I>provided</I> that the
Partnership shall bear such expenses of only a single representative of each Advisory Committee member, and (ii)&nbsp;provide reimbursement pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.07. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(f) Any member of the Advisory Committee may resign upon delivery of written notice from such member to the
General Partner. Any vacancy on the Advisory Committee, created by such a resignation may be filled by the General Partner (in consultation with the Investment Manager). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(g) No Specified Person Member shall owe any fiduciary duty to any Unitholder in respect of the activities of
such Specified Person. Any such Specified Person Member, in determining to take or refrain from taking any actions, shall be permitted to take into consideration only the interests of the Specified Person Member and, in so doing, shall not be
considered to have acted in bad faith; <I>provided</I> that, if an Advisory Committee member and / or the Unitholder represented by such member has a conflict of interest with the Partnership, any Other Investment Vehicles or any limited partner
thereof in connection with the transaction being considered, then such Advisory Committee member shall be required to disclose the conflict and may be required to recuse itself from any vote related to such conflict. To the extent that any member of
the Advisory Committee and / or the Unitholder represented by such member has a direct ownership interest in the Investment Manager, the General Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager) shall disclose such interest to the Advisory Committee.

Section&nbsp;2.05(b). Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, (i)&nbsp;a Specified Person Member shall not constitute a general partner of the Partnership and (ii)&nbsp;none of the actions taken by any Specified Person
Member or the Unitholders hereunder shall constitute participation in the control or conduct of the business of the Partnership within the meaning of the Delaware Act. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) The Partnership (and the General Partner, acting for and on behalf of the Partnership, in consultation with
the Investment Manager) shall have the power and authority to enter into, make and perform financing transactions and related undertakings (including guarantees), and engage in all such financing activities and transactions, as the General Partner

obtaining financing in respect of the Investments, leveraging on Investments, funding any relevant costs and expenses incurred in respect of this Agreement or any other purpose of the Partnership permitted under this Agreement, indebtedness for
borrowed money, including through credit arrangements, the issuance of notes and other evidence of indebtedness; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(ii) to incur other obligations, including in connection with Derivative Financial Instruments, letters of
credit and repurchase agreements, to make or arrange guarantees to support any such indebtedness or other obligations (including from Goldman Sachs) and incur reimbursement obligations in respect of any such guarantees; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iii) to pledge, encumber, grant a charge on, grant a security interest over or assign or otherwise make
available to support any such Financing any or all assets of the Partnership or such financing vehicle, including Investments and the Partnership&#8217;s direct or indirect interests in Portfolio Assets and / or rights related thereto; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iv) to permit any such Financing to be structured such that the Partnership, its subsidiaries and any other
financing vehicle could be jointly or jointly and severally responsible on a cross-guaranteed and / or cross-collateralized basis for the repayment thereof and / or the assets of such vehicles to be pledged on a joint or joint and several
cross-guaranteed and / or cross-collateralized basis to secure indebtedness obtained for the benefit of such vehicles; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(v) to take all other actions as the General Partner deems necessary or appropriate in connection with the
foregoing (collectively, clauses (i)&nbsp;through (v), &#8220;<B><U>Credit Support</U></B>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b)
The Partnership will not directly incur Indebtedness that would exceed 50% of the gross asset value of the Partnership (the &#8220;<B><U>Leverage Limit</U></B>&#8221;); <I>provided</I> that (a)&nbsp;the Partnership will not be in violation of the
foregoing as a result of any fluctuations in the Partnership&#8217;s gross asset value whether as a result of any distributions, redemptions, disposition of assets, fluctuations in the value of Investments or otherwise, (b)&nbsp;no remedial action
will be required if the Leverage Limit is exceeded for any reason other than the incurrence of an increase in indebtedness (including the exercise of rights attached to an Investment) and (c)&nbsp;the Partnership may incur additional indebtedness
for borrowed money that causes the indebtedness directly incurred by the Partnership to exceed the Leverage Limit to the extent the Investment Manager expects at the time of each such incurrence that such indebtedness shall be reduced to less than
or equal to the Leverage Limit within 9 months from the date the Leverage Limit was initially exceeded. </P>

this Section&nbsp;2.11(b), &#8220;<B><U>Indebtedness</U></B>&#8221; shall only include loans for borrowed money and shall exclude deferred purchase price obligations relating to property or services, obligations to make investments (including, for
the avoidance of doubt, obligations and commitments to fund loans), equity commitments (whether or not such equity commitments are for the specific purpose of repayment of obligations or otherwise), pledges of or grants of security interests in
collateral, other forms of credit support, Derivative Financial Instruments (including obligations in connection with hedging transactions) or any other hedging activities or contingent reimbursement obligations for letters of credit that have not
yet been honored (or any credit support provided by the Partnership, including in support of any of the foregoing obligations incurred by subsidiaries or investment vehicles of the Partnership) or any guarantees or credit support of the foregoing.
Only recourse indebtedness of, or guarantees by, the Partnership shall be considered indebtedness of the Partnership. For the avoidance of doubt, Indebtedness of the Partnership does not include (A)&nbsp;indebtedness of subsidiary vehicles or other
subsidiaries or investment vehicles of the Partnership (or any Other Investment Vehicle) except to the extent that the Partnership is liable for such indebtedness directly or as a guarantor with respect to a specific guarantee of indebtedness or
(B)&nbsp;indebtedness incurred by the Partnership on a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-recourse</FONT> basis. To the extent the Partnership, on the one hand, and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">G-Infra</FONT> Lux or other parties, on the other
hand, are liable for the same Indebtedness (including liability as a guarantor), the applicable Indebtedness will be allocated among such entities for purposes of the Leverage Limit (and any similar limits in the governing documents of the other
entities) in the Investment Manager&#8217;s discretion. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;2.12 <U>Fees Payable to </U><U>Goldman Sachs</U>.<U><SUP

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;2.14 <U>Board of Directors of the Partnership</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) The General Partner shall have the authority to select a board of directors for the Partnership (the
&#8220;<B><U>Partnership Board</U></B>&#8221;), comprised of no fewer than four (4)&nbsp;directors, at least half of whom are independent of Goldman Sachs and the Partnership under the tests set out in Rule 303A.02 of the New York Stock Exchange
Listed Company Manual or other policy as determined by General Partner (each of the independent directors, a &#8220;<B><U>Partnership Independent Director</U></B>&#8221; and each of the directors of the Partnership Board (including the Partnership
Independent Directors), a &#8220;<B><U>Partnership Director</U></B>&#8221;); <I>provided</I> that, if a Partnership Independent Director departs the Partnership Board by reason of death, disqualification, removal or resignation or ceases to be a
Partnership Independent Director for any reason, the requirement for <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-half</FONT> of the Partnership Board to be comprised of Partnership Independent Directors will be temporarily suspended for a period not to
exceed 180 days. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(i) The General Partner may appoint additional directors to the Partnership Board from
time to time. Each Partnership Independent Director shall serve a term of three years, which term is extendable or renewable by the General Partner in its sole discretion. Each Partnership Director who is not a Partnership Independent Director shall
serve as a Partnership Director until such Partnership Director&#8217;s death, resignation or removal by the General Partner pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.14(a)(iii). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(ii) The Partnership Board shall be responsible for overseeing management in the preparation of the
Partnership&#8217;s periodic reports under the Exchange Act and any other matters delegated to it by the General Partner. The Partnership Independent Directors shall review and approve or disapprove (A)&nbsp;any actual conflicts of interest in any
transaction or relationship between the Partnership, on the one hand, and the General Partner and/or its Affiliates, on the other hand, that the General Partner determines to present to the Partnership Board, and (B)&nbsp;any matter (x)&nbsp;for
which approval is required under the Advisers Act, including Sections 205(a) and 206(3) thereof, (y)&nbsp;as provided for under this Agreement or (z)&nbsp;as deemed appropriate by the General Partner, except, in each case of the immediately
preceding clauses (A)&nbsp;and (B), as contemplated by the terms of this Agreement. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">35 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(iii) A majority of the Partnership Independent Directors
are authorized to give or withhold the Partnership&#8217;s consent or approval as an &#8220;independent client representative&#8221; with respect to matters required by Section&nbsp;205(a) and Section&nbsp;206(3) of the Advisers Act and certain
other situations involving conflicts of interest, including with regards to the assignment or other transfer of Units by the General Partner for which a Majority in Interest or any Specified Person may provide its consent in accordance with
Section&nbsp;1.06(c) and the transfer to the Partnership of any investments warehoused by the Investment Manager or its Affiliates, in each case where presented to such Partnership Independent Directors in the General Partner&#8217;s sole
discretion. Each Unitholder (other than the General Partner) agrees that, with respect to any consent sought from the Partnership Independent Directors under this provision, such consent of the Partnership Independent Directors shall be binding upon
the Partnership, the General Partner, the Investment Manager and their Affiliates, acting in accordance with or pursuant to such consent (or such procedures or standards approved by the Partnership Independent Directors), shall, absent actual fraud
or willful misconduct, be fully protected and justified in acting in reliance upon and in accordance with such consent of the Partnership Independent Directors. Any matters for which the Partnership Board or Partnership Independent Directors have
authority to act can be effected by majority approval of the Partnership Board or Partnership Independent Directors, as applicable. If there are only two Partnership Independent Directors, matters requiring consent or approval of a majority of the
Partnership Independent Directors will require approval of both Partnership Independent Directors. For the avoidance of doubt, if for any period of time not exceeding 180 days, the Partnership Board is comprised of, or temporarily consists of, only
one Partnership Independent Director, matters requiring the consent or approval of a majority of the Partnership Independent Directors shall be satisfied by the consent or approval of such Partnership Independent Director. Subject to the foregoing,
the General Partner shall have the right, following consultation with the Investment Manager, to change or replace any Partnership Independent Director for Cause and any Partnership Director that is not an Independent Director with or without Cause.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) The General Partner may, but is not required to, obtain approval of the Partnership Independent
Directors for (i)&nbsp;the suspension of (x)&nbsp;the calculation of the NAV of the Units, (y)&nbsp;the Partnership&#8217;s offering of Units pursuant to the Offering Memorandum or (z)&nbsp;the Unit Redemption Plan, (ii)&nbsp;any material
modification to (x)&nbsp;the Partnership&#8217;s valuation policies and (y)&nbsp;the Unit Redemption Plan and (iii)&nbsp;fair valuation of any investment in a company or other private asset of the Partnership that the General Partner has determined
to value outside of the applicable range provided by the Partnership&#8217;s independent valuation advisor. If such Partnership Board approval is sought, the General Partner will present to the Partnership Board the basis for any such proposed
suspension or modification and will notify the Partnership Independent Directors of any change in the independent valuation advisor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c) The Partnership Board (including the Partnership Independent Directors) shall owe a duty to use their
reasonable business judgment to act in the best interests of the Partnership with respect to matters of the Partnership that are within the Partnership Board&#8217;s authority. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(d) The Partnership Board may create an audit committee (the &#8220;<B><U>Audit Committee</U></B>&#8221;)
consisting solely of the Partnership Independent Directors. The Audit Committee, among other matters, (i)&nbsp;will approve the Partnership&#8217;s auditor, as selected by the General Partner, (ii)&nbsp;will review the Partnership&#8217;s financial
statements and (iii)&nbsp;will handle such other matters as may be delegated to the Audit Committee by the Partnership Board. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE
III </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CLASSES; SERIES; ADMISSION OF NEW UNITHOLDERS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;3.01 <U>Classes; Series</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) Units may be divided into one or more different classes of Units (&#8220;<B><U>Classes</U></B>&#8221; and
each a &#8220;<B><U>Class</U></B>&#8221;) and one or more series of Classes (each or collectively, as the context requires, a &#8220;<B><U>Series</U></B>&#8221;) in the sole discretion of the General Partner. In this Agreement, except when referred
to under their separate Classes or Series or where the context otherwise requires, the term &#8220;<B><U>Units</U></B>&#8221; shall mean all Classes, including all Series thereof. Unless the General Partner otherwise determines, the initial issue
</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">36 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">
price per Unit of any Class&nbsp;or any Series shall be as set forth in the Offering Memorandum. Thereafter, any additional Units of such class or series will be issued at a price per Unit equal
to the then NAV per Unit of such class or series, as applicable, immediately after the close of business on the applicable Subscription Date (after giving effect to any distributions, redemptions of Units (including any Early Exit Fee) and Carried
Interest (including accruals thereof) as of such Subscription Date). Fractions of Units may be issued to one thousandth of a Unit (subject to any rounding to one thousandth of a Unit). Each Class&nbsp;and each Series may be subject to different
terms and conditions, including potentially different fee, currency, dealing, transfer, information disclosure, liquidity arrangements, distribution policies, investor types, or any other criteria to be determined by the General Partner in its sole
discretion. Each Unit within the same Class&nbsp;or Series will carry equal rights and privileges with each other Unit of the same Class&nbsp;or Series, as applicable. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) The General Partner is hereby authorized to cause the Partnership to issue the Classes and Series with such
terms, rights and obligations as determined by the General Partner in consultation with the Investment Manager. The terms applicable to each Class&nbsp;and Series shall be as set forth in the Offering Memorandum and, to the extent there is any
conflict between the terms of a particular Class&nbsp;or Series set forth in the Offering Memorandum and the terms set forth in this Agreement, the terms set forth in the Offering Memorandum shall control with respect to such Class&nbsp;or Series,
as applicable; <I>provided</I>, for the avoidance of doubt, that such conflicting terms and conditions in the Offering Memorandum shall only control to the extent that they (i)&nbsp;would not violate Section&nbsp;9.03 had such terms and conditions
been reflected in an amendment to this Agreement and (ii)&nbsp;are with respect to a particular Class&nbsp;or Series and are not generally applicable to all Unitholders. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c) The General Partner, in consultation with the Investment Manager, may, at any time and from time to time,
in its discretion, elect to raise additional capital for the Partnership from the Unitholders and from new subscribers on such terms and conditions as may be determined by the General Partner in its discretion (in consultation with the Investment
Manager). In addition, the General Partner, in consultation with the Investment Manager may amend or vary the terms or characteristics of any existing Class&nbsp;or Series. Should the General Partner decide to issue one or more Classes or Series
that are not listed in the Offering Memorandum, or to change any of the terms or characteristics of any existing Class&nbsp;or Series, the Offering Memorandum will be revised or supplemented; <I>provided</I> that any amendments to the terms of
existing Classes or Series shall only be effective if amended by the General Partner in accordance with Section&nbsp;9.03 of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;3.02 <U>Conversion and Consolidation of Units</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">No conversion of Units between the different Classes or Series shall be permitted except as permitted by the General Partner
(as delegated to the Investment Manager); <I>provided</I> that the General Partner in its sole discretion may consolidate two or more Classes and/or Series by effectuating an exchange of Units of a Class&nbsp;or Series into one or more other
existing Classes or Series or one or more newly created Classes or Series (each such consolidated Class, a &#8220;<B><U>Consolidated Class</U></B>&#8221; and each such consolidated Series, a &#8220;<B><U>Consolidated Series</U></B>&#8221;, in each
case, whether effectuated by exchange, consolidation, conversion, redesignation or otherwise). In addition, the General Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager) may convert Units of one Class,
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-class,</FONT> Series or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-series</FONT> into Units of another Class, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-class,</FONT> Series or
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-series</FONT> in certain circumstances as provided herein. Any conversion or consolidation pursuant to this Agreement shall be effected by book entry without the need for further action by any holder and shall be
final and binding on the Unitholders absent manifest error. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Effective as of August 24, 2026, the Partnership
(i)&nbsp;created (A) a single Class&nbsp;of common Units (the &#8220;<B><U>Common Class</U></B>&#8221;) with multiple Series thereof (each or collectively, as the context requires, &#8220;<B><U>Common
Class</U></B><B><U></U></B><B><U>&nbsp;Series</U></B>&#8221;) as described in the Offering Memorandum and (B)&nbsp;an additional single Class&nbsp;of common Units (the &#8220;<B><U>Select Class</U></B>&#8221;) with multiple Series thereof (each or
collectively, as the context requires, &#8220;<B><U>Select Class</U></B><B><U></U></B><B><U>&nbsp;Series</U></B>&#8221;, and together with the Common Class&nbsp;Series, each or collectively, as the context requires, &#8220;<B><U>Consolidated
Class</U></B><B><U></U></B><B><U>&nbsp;Series</U></B>&#8221;) as described in the Offering Memorandum and (ii)&nbsp;simultaneously therewith, redesignated all other Classes then in existence immediately before the creation of each such Consolidated
Class&nbsp;into the applicable Consolidated Class&nbsp;Series, as described in the Offering Memorandum (clauses (i)&nbsp;and (ii) together, the &#8220;<B><U>Redesignation</U></B>&#8221;). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">37 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;3.03 <U>Subscriptions</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) Each person shall be admitted to the Partnership as a Unitholder of the Partnership upon (i)&nbsp;the
completion by such Person of a Subscription Booklet and the acceptance thereof by the General Partner on behalf of the Partnership and (ii)&nbsp;the execution by or on behalf of such Person of a counterpart signature page to this Agreement. Each
Unitholder has paid or conveyed by way of contribution to the Partnership in exchange for the issuance of Units cash and / or securities or other assets in the amount set forth in the books and records of the Partnership (the
&#8220;<B><U>Subscription</U></B>&#8221;). Additional Subscriptions may be made by Unitholders only in accordance with the provisions of this Section&nbsp;3.03. Admission of a new Unitholder shall not be a cause for dissolution or termination of the
Partnership. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) Any existing or prospective Unitholder may request to purchase additional or newly-issued
Units by contributing cash, or in the General Partner&#8217;s sole discretion securities or other assets, to the Partnership on the last Business Day of each calendar month or at such other times as the General Partner may determine in its
discretion (each such date, a &#8220;<B><U>Subscription Date</U></B>,&#8221; and each such request, a &#8220;<B><U>Subscription Request</U></B>&#8221;). The General Partner (or any other person to whom such powers have been delegated by the General
Partner) may reject or accept Subscription Requests in whole or in part in its sole discretion, and in particular may determine in the best interests of Unitholders that part or all of a subscription request should be deferred to one or more later
Subscription Dates. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c) The General Partner may declare additional or more frequent Subscription Dates in
its sole discretion. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;3.04 <U>Adjustment to Number of </U><U>Units</U><U> Issued</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">If at any time the General Partner determines, in consultation with the Investment Manager, that an incorrect number of Units
was issued to a Unitholder because the NAV of the Partnership or the applicable Class&nbsp;in effect on the date of issuance was incorrect under the Investment Manager&#8217;s valuation and determination of NAV policies and procedures, the General
Partner may (in consultation with the Investment Manager) implement such arrangements as it determines, in consultation with the Investment Manager, are required for an equitable treatment of such Unitholder, which arrangements may include redeeming
a portion of such Unitholder&#8217;s Units for no additional consideration or issuing new Units to such Unitholder for no consideration, as appropriate, so that the number of Units held by such Unitholder following such redemption or issuance, as
the case may be, is the number of Units that would have been issued at the correct NAV. In addition, the General Partner may, in consultation with the Investment Manager, authorize the correction of errors made in the processing of subscriptions of
Units. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;3.05 <U>Additional Classes and Series</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">From time to time, the Partnership may, in the sole discretion of the General Partner and without notice to the Unitholders
(other than the General Partner), issue one or more additional Classes and/or Series, including, without limitation, Classes and/or Series that are subject to fee and compensation arrangements, liquidity and/or other terms (including with respect to
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">lock-up</FONT> periods and other redemption terms) that are different from any Class&nbsp;and/or Series then outstanding. The General Partner may, without the prior consent of or notice to the Unitholders, make
appropriate revisions to or supplement the Offering Memorandum and this Agreement to the extent necessary or desirable to effect the issuance of Units of any such Class&nbsp;and/or Series, including to account for different fee arrangements,
liquidity and/or other terms (including with respect to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">lock-up</FONT> periods and other redemption terms) or the separate currency-related transactions engaged in with respect to such a Class&nbsp;and/or Series.
</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">38 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE IV </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CLASS&nbsp;ACCOUNTS, SERIES ACCOUNTS AND SUB-ACCOUNTS OF UNITHOLDERS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>AND OPERATION THEREOF </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.01 <U>Class</U><U> Accounts</U><U>; Series Accounts</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) The Partnership shall maintain a separate account on the books of the Partnership for each Class (a
&#8220;<B><U>Class</U></B><B><U></U></B><B><U>&nbsp;Account</U></B>&#8221;) and for each Series thereof (a &#8220;<B><U>Series Account</U></B>&#8221;); <I>provided</I> that the Partnership may maintain a Series Account for each Series of a
Class&nbsp;in lieu of maintaining a Class&nbsp;Account for such Class (including, for the avoidance of doubt, that the Partnership may maintain a Series Account for each Consolidated Class&nbsp;Series in lieu of maintaining a Class&nbsp;Account for
the applicable Consolidated Class), as determined by General Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager) in its sole discretion. Each Class&nbsp;Account with respect to a Class&nbsp;and each Series Account with respect to a Series will, as
applicable, be (i)&nbsp;increased by the amount of any Subscriptions in respect of such Class&nbsp;or such Series, (ii)&nbsp;decreased to reflect the redemption of any Units of such Class&nbsp;or such Series and any Early Exit Fee charged in respect
thereof, (iii)&nbsp;decreased to reflect the amount of distributions (other than in respect of the redemption of Units) in respect of such Class&nbsp;or such Series (including any deemed distribution of taxes paid by the Partnership pursuant to
Section&nbsp;5.06 in respect of such Class&nbsp;or such Series), (iv) increased or decreased by such Class&#8217;s or such Series&#8217; allocable share of the Net Capital Appreciation or Net Capital Depreciation of the net assets of the Partnership
(as determined pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.03) for each Accounting Period, (v)&nbsp;increased by such Class&#8217;s or such Series&#8217; allocable share of the benefit of any Early Exit Fee pursuant to Section&nbsp;5.02(d), (vi) decreased (or
increased in the case of Series A Units) for any Carried Interest in respect of such Class&nbsp;or such Series pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.01(d) and Section&nbsp;4.04 and (vii)&nbsp;decreased for any Management Fee and / or any Servicing Fee in
respect of such Class&nbsp;or such Series, if and as applicable, as determined pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.06. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) At the time of the conversion of any Class&nbsp;or of any Series into any other Class&nbsp;or any other
Series pursuant to this Agreement, the Class&nbsp;Account of the converted Class&nbsp;or the Series Account of the converted Series, as applicable, shall be reduced to zero, and the Class&nbsp;Account of the Class&nbsp;or the Series Account of the
Series, as applicable, into which such Units were converted shall be increased by the balance of the Class&nbsp;Account of the converted Class&nbsp;or the Series Account of the converted Series, as applicable, immediately prior to the conversion.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c) A separate account shall also be established on the books and records of the Partnership for each
Unitholder with respect to each Class&nbsp;and with respect to each Series held by such Unitholder (a &#8220;<B><U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Account</FONT></U></B>&#8221;); <I>provided</I> that, if a Class&nbsp;does not have a
corresponding Class&nbsp;Account pursuant to Section&nbsp;4.01(a), the Partnership shall not be required to establish <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Accounts</FONT> with respect to such Class (including, for the avoidance of doubt, that the
Partnership shall not be required to establish <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Accounts</FONT> with respect to a Consolidated Class&nbsp;in the event the Partnership maintains Series Accounts for each Consolidated Class&nbsp;Series of such
Consolidated Class). Each Unitholder&#8217;s <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(i)&nbsp;Sub-Account</FONT> with respect to a Class (if any) shall equal the Class&nbsp;Account of such Class&nbsp;multiplied by the Class&nbsp;Percentage with respect to
such Class&nbsp;and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(ii)&nbsp;Sub-Account</FONT> with respect to a Series shall equal the Series Account of such Series multiplied by the Series Percentage with respect to such Series. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(d) At the end of each annual or other period in which the Carry Recipients are entitled to receive Carried
Interest from the Partnership in respect of a Series in accordance with this Agreement, the Net Capital Appreciation initially or previously allocated to such Series shall be debited from the Series Account of such Series and associated <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Accounts</FONT> of the Unitholders of each such Series and credited to the Series Account of the Series A Units. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(e) Class Accounts, Series Accounts, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Accounts</FONT> and
Unitholders&#8217; Units (and corresponding accounts maintained for tax allocation purposes) will be appropriately adjusted for exchanges or conversions of Units of one Class&nbsp;or Series for Units of another Class&nbsp;or Series, including in
connection with the Redesignation and including to take into account the fact that different fees and </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">39 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">
expenses may be borne by different Classes or Series, and for other events and items as determined by the General Partner (in consultation with the Investment Manager), including taxes incurred
on behalf of Unitholders<U> </U>or other expenses or liabilities that may be borne disproportionately. For the avoidance of doubt, in order to effect the foregoing as well as any other rights attaching to less than all Units, the Partnership may
cancel or redeem Units, issue Units in a separate Class, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Class,</FONT> Series or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Series,</FONT> and may convert the Units held by any such Unitholders into a separate Class, <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Class,</FONT> Series or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Series</FONT> of Units, including, in each case, in connection with the Redesignation. Furthermore, the Partnership may consolidate Units of two or more
Classes, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Classes,</FONT> Series or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-Series</FONT> where separate tracking of such Units is no longer necessary or advisable (any such consolidation, a &#8220;<B><U><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Roll-Up</FONT></U></B>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.02 <U>Series Percentages;
Class</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;Percentages</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">A series percentage (a &#8220;<B><U>Series Percentage</U></B>&#8221;) shall be
determined for each Unitholder for any given Series for each Accounting Period of the Partnership by dividing (i)&nbsp;the number of Units owned by such Unitholder within a given Series by (ii)&nbsp;the aggregate number of outstanding Units of such
Series as of the beginning of such Accounting Period. The aggregate Series Percentages for each Series shall equal 100%. To the extent a Class&nbsp;Account is maintained for a given Class, such Class&#8217;s class percentage (a
&#8220;<B><U>Class</U></B><B><U></U></B><B><U>&nbsp;Percentage</U></B>&#8221;) shall be determined for each Unitholder for any given Class&nbsp;for each Accounting Period of the Partnership by dividing (i)&nbsp;the number of Units owned by such
Unitholder within a given Class&nbsp;by (ii)&nbsp;the aggregate number of outstanding Units of such Class&nbsp;as of<B> </B>the beginning of such Accounting Period. The aggregate Class&nbsp;Percentages for each Class&nbsp;shall equal 100%. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.03 <U>Allocation of Net Capital Appreciation or Net Capital Depreciation</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Any Net Capital Appreciation or Net Capital Depreciation, as the case may be, for an Accounting Period shall be allocated among
the different Classes and the different Series (excluding, for the avoidance of doubt, Series A Units) <I>pro rata</I> in accordance with the relative Class&nbsp;Accounts and Series Accounts, as applicable (determined prior to any <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-to-date</FONT></FONT> accrued Carried Interest), of each such Class&nbsp;and Series as of the beginning of such Accounting Period, after giving effect to any subscriptions as of the
beginning of such Accounting Period (but, for the avoidance of doubt, without reduction for any Management Fees or Servicing Fees paid or accrued during such Accounting Period). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.04 <U>Carried Interest</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) The Carry Recipients shall be entitled to receive carried interest (the &#8220;<B><U>Carried
Interest</U></B>&#8221;) from the Partnership with respect to each Series subject thereto, which shall be accrued monthly and allocated to the Carry Recipients in respect of their Series A Units as of the last Business Day of each calendar year or
upon any redemption of Units (with respect to such redeemed Units); <I>provided</I> that (i)&nbsp;no Carried Interest shall be charged or accrued during the first six (6)&nbsp;months following the First Closing, and the last day of such six-month
period shall be treated as the end of a Carried Interest period for purposes of calculating future Carried Interest, including that the Hurdle Amount calculation will reset, (ii)&nbsp;if the Investment Manager is removed in accordance with the terms
of this Agreement (including <U>Exhibit B</U> attached hereto), the Carry Recipients shall be allocated any accrued Carried Interest in accordance with Section&nbsp;2.04(d) hereof and (iii)&nbsp;immediately prior to the Partnership&#8217;s final
liquidating distribution in connection with its dissolution, any accrued Carried Interest shall be allocated to the Carry Recipients as if the date of such final liquidating distribution were the last Business Day of a calendar year. Notwithstanding
anything herein to the contrary, the Carried Interest shall be calculated and allocated separately in respect of each relevant Series (<I>i.e.</I>, the Carried Interest in respect of a Series shall be based solely upon the Total Returns, Hurdle
Amount and High Water Mark attributable to such Series) as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(i) <I>First</I>, if the Total Return
for the applicable annual or other period exceeds the sum of (A)&nbsp;the Hurdle Amount for such period and (B)&nbsp;the High Water Mark (any such excess, &#8220;<B><U>Excess Profits</U></B>&#8221;), 100% of such Excess Profits until the total
amount allocated to the Carry Recipients equals 12.5% of the sum of (x)&nbsp;the Hurdle Amount for such period and (y)&nbsp;any amount allocated to the Carry Recipients pursuant to this Section&nbsp;4.04(a)(i); and </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">40 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(ii) <I>Second</I>, to the extent there are remaining Excess
Profits, 12.5% of such remaining Excess Profits shall be allocated to the Carry Recipients. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) Any amount
by which Total Return falls below the Hurdle Amount will not be carried forward to subsequent periods. For any annual or other relevant period, the Total Returns, Hurdle Amount and High Water Mark will be appropriately adjusted for any
subscriptions, redemptions and distributions during, or in respect of, such period. For the avoidance of doubt, Carried Interest accruals will be included in the NAV per Unit at which subscriptions and redemptions are effected. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, the Carry Recipients&#8217; right to receive
Carried Interest and/or any tax distribution amounts with respect thereto may be implemented (in whole or in part, but in any event without duplication) at the level of one or more subsidiary vehicles of the Partnership and, in any such case,
distributions and allocations which any Unitholder is otherwise entitled to receive from the Partnership will be appropriately reduced, and any other appropriate adjustments may be made to give effect to the foregoing. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(d) Upon the allocation of the Carried Interest as of the last Business Day of the applicable calendar year or
in connection with the redemption of Units, the Partnership will either issue new Series A Units to the Carry Recipients with an aggregate NAV equal to the amount of the Carried Interest or increase the aggregate NAV of any outstanding Series A
Units by such amount, or a combination thereof, at the option of the Carry Recipients. For the avoidance of doubt, Series A Units shall not be allocated any Net Capital Appreciation or Net Capital Depreciation or otherwise participate in the
performance of the Partnership other than in respect of the Carried Interest. Carried Interest accruals will be included in the NAV per Unit at which subscriptions and redemptions are effected. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(e) The General Partner may, in its discretion (as delegated to the Investment Manager), cause the Partnership
to distribute Carried Interest to Carry Recipients by way of distributions in respect of, or by a redemption or partial redemption of their Series A Units. Any such redemptions of Series A Units may occur as of any date (including <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-Redemption</FONT> Dates) and shall not be subject to any prior notice requirements, the Redemption Cap or Early Exit Fee. The General Partner may, in its discretion (as delegated to the Investment Manager), also cause
all or part of any Carried Interest amounts payable to one or more Carry Recipients (including by means of an Employee Fund or carry plan) to be paid by way of the issue of, or exchanging Series A Units into, Units of another Series or
Class&nbsp;which participates in the Net Capital Appreciation and Net Capital Depreciation of the Partnership and / or units or interests of one or more of the Partnership&#8217;s subsidiary vehicles. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(f) Notwithstanding anything in this Section&nbsp;4.04 to the contrary, cash of the Partnership not
attributable to an allocation of Carried Interest may, at the discretion of the General Partner (in consultation with Goldman Sachs), be distributed to the Carry Recipients as an advance against future Carried Interest in amounts necessary for the
Carry Recipients to pay tax with respect to income allocated to them by the Partnership (or a subsidiary thereof). All calculations of tax distribution amounts will be calculated based on certain assumptions as reasonably determined by Goldman Sachs
and using the highest marginal tax rates applicable to individuals residing in New York, New York. Any such tax distributions shall reduce the NAV of the applicable Series at the time of the distribution (other than for purposes of determining Total
Returns) and will reduce the amount of any future Carried Interest in respect of the applicable Series on a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">dollar-for-dollar</FONT></FONT> basis. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(g) Carry Recipients may elect to defer or waive the distribution of Carried Interest. Any amounts of Carried
Interest deferred or waived by the Carry Recipients may be used by the Partnership for any purpose permitted by this Agreement. To the extent deferred or waived, the Carried Interest may subsequently be distributed to the Carry Recipients upon the
election of the Carry Recipients. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, any such deferral may be implemented by distribution of Carried Interest amounts (including by way of distributions or redemptions in respect of Series A Units as
set forth above) in the form of a note (which, for the avoidance of doubt, shall reduce the NAV of the Series A Units by the principal amount thereof). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">41 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.05 <U>Amendment of Carried Interest</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">The Investment Manager reserves the right to partially or completely waive any Carried Interest arrangements, or to apply no
such Carried Interest or Carried Interest that is greater or less than or in other ways different from the Carried Interest described in this Agreement, in respect of certain Unitholders (including Affiliates or personnel of Goldman Sachs), as may
be agreed to by the Investment Manager and such Unitholders, and the Investment Manager may make appropriate amendments to or supplement this Agreement (including in connection with the creation of additional Series or Class) if required to reflect
any such arrangements without notice to or the consent of other Unitholders. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.06 <U>Determination of Net
Assets</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) The Partnership&#8217;s Net Assets shall be determined as of the close of business on the last Business
Day of each calendar month and any other Accounting <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Period-end</FONT> (each, a &#8220;<B><U>Valuation Day</U></B>&#8221;) according to such procedures as may be established from time to time by the Investment
Manager, in its sole discretion; <I>provided</I> that the General Partner (in consultation with the Investment Manager) may provide reserves for estimated accrued expenses, liabilities and contingencies. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) The amount payable to a Unitholder or former Unitholder to redeem part or all of such Unitholder&#8217;s or former
Unitholder&#8217;s Units pursuant to Section&nbsp;5.02 shall be treated as a liability of the Partnership, until paid, from (but not prior to) the beginning of the Accounting Period that begins immediately after the close of business on the
Redemption Date for such Units. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c) The amount to be received by the Partnership on account of any Subscriptions pursuant
to Section&nbsp;3.03 shall be treated as an asset of the Partnership from (but not before) the beginning of the Accounting Period that begins immediately after the close of business on the applicable Subscription Date. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(d) Distributions (other than in connection with a redemption of Units pursuant to Section&nbsp;5.02) made pursuant to
Section&nbsp;5.05 and deemed tax distributions pursuant to Section&nbsp;5.06 other than as of the beginning or end of an Accounting Period shall be treated as an advance and as an asset of the Partnership, through the end of the Accounting Period
following the date of the distribution. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(e) Without limiting the generality of Section&nbsp;5.03, the Partnership may
suspend the determination of Net Assets and NAV, the Partnership&#8217;s offering of Units and any distributions in respect of or redemptions of Units, for any period in the event the General Partner (in consultation with the Investment Manager)
determines such suspension to be in the best interests of the Partnership and / or the Unitholders. No Units will be issued or redeemed (as applicable) during any such suspension, except as the General Partner (in consultation with the Investment
Manager) determines is in the best interests of the Partnership and / or the Unitholders in order to address an applicable legal, tax or regulatory consideration. The General Partner shall promptly notify Unitholders of any such suspension, and the
termination of any such suspension, by means of a written notice. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(f) All values assigned to securities and other assets
of the Partnership pursuant to this Section&nbsp;4.06 shall be final and conclusive as to all of the Unitholders. The Partnership and the General Partner may consult with and rely upon valuations of the Partnership&#8217;s securities and other
assets provided by the Administrator. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(g) In no event will the Partnership or the General Partner incur any liability or
responsibility to the Unitholders for any valuation determination made or other valuation action taken or omitted by it in good faith. In addition, neither the Partnership nor the General Partner will be liable to the Unitholders for errors in
valuations as a result of any incorrect information provided by third parties. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">42 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.07 <U>Determination of Net Asset Value</U>. <U></U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">The NAV of the Partnership shall be equal to the aggregate of the NAV of each Class. The NAV of a Class&nbsp;is equal to the
balance of the Class&nbsp;Account with respect to such Class (or if no Class&nbsp;Account has been established with respect to a Class, then the NAV of such Class&nbsp;is equal to the aggregate balance of all Series Accounts with respect to such
Class) and the NAV of a Series is equal to the balance of the Series Account with respect to such Series; provided, in any case and for the avoidance of doubt, that any Series Account and Class&nbsp;Account with respect to the same Class&nbsp;shall
not be double counted for purposes of determining NAV. The NAV per Unit of (a)&nbsp;a Class&nbsp;shall be equal to the NAV of such Class&nbsp;divided by the number of outstanding Units of such Class&nbsp;and (b)&nbsp;a Series shall be equal to the
NAV of such Series divided by the number of outstanding Units of such Series. For the avoidance of doubt, (i)&nbsp;all calculations of NAV described herein shall be made according to such procedures as may be established from time to time by the
Investment Manager, in its sole discretion, (ii)&nbsp;calculations of Transactional NAV, to the extent that they incorporate valuations of certain of the Partnership&#8217;s assets and liabilities, are not required to be prepared in accordance with
U.S. GAAP and (iii)&nbsp;any valuation or other adjustments made to the Partnership&#8217;s assets and liabilities in connection with the determination of GAAP NAV are not required to be reflected in the calculation of the Transactional NAV for the
applicable period. In addition, the determination of NAV may be suspended for any period in accordance with Section&nbsp;4.06(e). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.08 <U>Allocation</U><U>s</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) may make such allocations of items of
income, gain, loss and expenses as it deems reasonably necessary to give economic effect to the provisions of this Agreement, and to ensure that allocations are in accordance with the Unitholder&#8217;s interests in the Partnership, as reasonably
determined by the General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) and taking into account such facts and circumstances as it deems reasonably necessary for this purpose. In furtherance of the foregoing, the General Partner (or, by
delegation, the Investment Manager) in its discretion may allocate items of gross or net income and / or gross or net deduction to the extent it deems appropriate to achieve the desired allocations consistent with the foregoing or to the extent
required by law, and may determine that an equitable method of allocation includes, without limitation, an allocation of most items of income pro rata based on the relative differences between amounts allocated to the Class&nbsp;Accounts and/or
Series Accounts maintained on the books of the Partnership and the aggregate amounts of items of income, gain, loss and expenses allocated to the relevant Class&nbsp;and/or Series (including, for the avoidance of doubt, the Series A Units).
Allocations for U.S. federal income tax purposes shall be made in a manner consistent with the foregoing and in accordance with each Unitholder&#8217;s interests in the Partnership. The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager)
shall determine all matters concerning allocations for tax purposes not expressly provided for herein in its discretion and expects to take into account for these purposes the allocation principles detailed in <U>Exhibit D</U> attached hereto, as
may be amended from time to time. To the extent there is an adjustment by a taxing authority to any item of income, gain, loss, deduction or credit of the Partnership (or an adjustment to any Unitholder&#8217;s distributive share thereof), the
General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) may reallocate the adjusted items among each Class&nbsp;and/or Series (and items allocated to a Class&nbsp;or Series may be allocated among the relevant
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Accounts</FONT> of the Unitholders of such Class&nbsp;or Series, as applicable) (as determined by the General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager)) as determined pursuant to such audit adjustment.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) Notwithstanding the foregoing, any allocation to an Affiliated Unitholder or a Carry Recipient
attributable, or otherwise related, to such Unitholder&#8217;s Units representing an equity interest (as opposed to an entitlement to Carried Interest) is intended to qualify as a &#8220;Capital Interest Allocation&#8221; within the meaning of U.S.
Treasury Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;1.1061-3(c)(3),</FONT> and the provisions of this Agreement relating to distributions and allocations shall be interpreted consistent with that intention. In accordance with the
foregoing, (i)&nbsp;all such allocations to an Affiliated Unitholder or a Carry Recipient, and allocations to each other Unitholder attributable to contributions or otherwise relating to contributions by such Unitholder, shall be determined and
calculated in a similar manner (within the meaning of U.S. Treasury Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;1.1061-3(c)(3)(ii)),</FONT> (ii) all such allocations shall be determined and
</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">43 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">
calculated separate and apart, within the meaning of U.S. Treasury Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;1.1061-3(c)(3)(ii)(B),</FONT> from allocations in respect of Carried
Interest to a Carry Recipient or allocations otherwise not attributable to or relating to contributions, and (iii)&nbsp;the Partnership shall consistently reflect the separately identified allocations described in clauses (i)&nbsp;and (ii) in its
contemporaneous books and records. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;4.09 <U>Determination by General Partner of Certain Matters; General
Partner</U><U>&#8217;</U><U>s Discretion</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) All matters concerning the valuation of securities and
other assets and liabilities of the Partnership, the allocation of profits, gains and losses among the Unitholders (including for tax purposes) and accounting procedures not expressly provided for by the terms of this Agreement shall be determined
by the General Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager), whose determination shall be final, binding and conclusive as to all of the Unitholders. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, whenever in this Agreement the General Partner is
permitted or required to make a decision (i)&nbsp;in its &#8220;sole discretion&#8221; or &#8220;discretion,&#8221; &#8220;judgment,&#8221; or under a similar grant of authority or latitude, the General Partner shall be entitled to consider only
such interests and factors as it desires, including<B> </B>its own interests and the interests of its Affiliates, and shall have no duty or obligation to give any consideration to any interest of or factors affecting the Partnership or the
Unitholders, and its determination shall be final, binding and conclusive as to all of the Unitholders, or (ii)&nbsp;in its &#8220;good faith,&#8221; the General Partner shall act under such express standards and shall not be subject to any other or
different standards imposed by this Agreement or by law or any other agreement contemplated herein. Each Unitholder hereby agrees that, to the fullest extent permitted by law, any standard of care or duty imposed in this Agreement or any other
agreement contemplated herein or under the Delaware Act or any other applicable law, rule or regulation shall be modified, waived or limited in each case as required to permit the General Partner to act under this Agreement or any other agreement
contemplated herein and to make any decisions, in each case pursuant to the authority prescribed in this Section&nbsp;4.09(b). In no way does this Section&nbsp;4.09(b)<B> </B>eliminate or modify the General Partner&#8217;s implied contractual
covenant of good faith and fair dealing under the Delaware Act. In addition, in no way shall this Section&nbsp;4.09(b) constitute a waiver or limitation of the General Partner&#8217;s potential liability, or of any rights which a Unitholder or the
Partnership may have, under applicable securities laws or other laws which may not be waived, including fiduciary duties, if any, owed by the General Partner to the Partnership under the Advisers Act. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE V </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>REDEMPTIONS
AND DISTRIBUTIONS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Section&nbsp;5.01 <U>Redemptions and Distributions in General</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a) No Unitholder shall be entitled (i)&nbsp;to receive distributions from the Partnership, except as provided
in Section&nbsp;5.05 and Section&nbsp;7.02; or (ii)&nbsp;to have any of its Units redeemed by the Partnership, except as provided in Section&nbsp;5.02 and Section&nbsp;6.01 or upon the consent of, or as may be required by, and upon such terms as may
be determined by, the General Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager). In no event shall a Unitholder be entitled to demand to receive property other than cash. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, the Partnership, and the General
Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager) on behalf of the Partnership, shall not be required to make a distribution to any Unitholder in respect of its Units if such distribution would violate the Delaware Act or other applicable law. </P>
